title: ZimaBlade pfSense 2.5GbE Firewall & OpenVPN Gateway
subtitle: Compact x86 edge router deployment with Dual 2.5G NIC expansion running pfSense and encrypted OpenVPN
summary: Deployed pfSense on an IceWhale ZimaBlade x86 single-board computer expanded with a Dual 2.5G PCIe NIC to serve as a high-throughput, multi-gigabit edge firewall and gateway. Configured an OpenVPN server to enable secure, encrypted remote tunneling into internal network subnets.
highlights: Provisioned pfSense on a ZimaBlade SBC equipped with a Dual 2.5GbE NIC, upgrading network throughput to multi-gigabit speeds across WAN and LAN interfaces.
Configured a dedicated OpenVPN server using SSL/TLS certificate-based authentication and TLS key authorization for hardened remote access.
Established custom firewall rules, NAT policies, and static routes to control ingress/egress traffic between VPN clients and local subnets.
Generated customized Client Export profiles bundled with SSL certificates for seamless cross-platform client onboarding.

techSpecs.Core Capabilities: 2.5G Routing, Stateful Firewall, NAT, OpenVPN Server
